name: shipment_get_status
description: Query current shipment status by tracking number. Returns current location, status, ETA, and carrier information.

tracking_number.description: The shipment tracking number. Format: FR followed by exactly 14 digits (e.g., FR20260930000123).

name: shipment_get_history
description: Get full tracking history for a shipment. Returns all events from pickup to delivery with timestamps and locations.

tracking_number.description: The shipment tracking number. Format: FR followed by exactly 14 digits.

name: shipment_list_by_route
description: List shipments filtered by origin and/or destination city names (at least one of origin or destination is required). Status and date range are supplementary filters. Returns a summary list of matching shipments.

origin.description: Filter by origin city name (partial match supported). Optional.

destination.description: Filter by destination city name (partial match supported). Optional.

date_from.description: Filter shipments with pickup date on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

date_to.description: Filter shipments with pickup date on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of shipments to return (1-50, default 50).

name: route_recommend_options
description: Recommend optimal routes between origin and destination. Returns multiple route options with distance, time, and cost.

origin.description: Origin city or facility name. Required.

destination.description: Destination city or facility name. Required.

cargo_type.description: Cargo category. Optional. Used to filter routes with restrictions.

priority.description: Optimization priority: 'cost' for cheapest, 'time' for fastest, 'balanced' for trade-off.

name: route_get_details
description: Get detailed route information by route ID. Returns waypoints, service stations, road types, and restrictions.

route_id.description: Route identifier from route recommendation. Format: R followed by 3 digits (e.g., R001).

name: route_check_restrictions
description: Check if cargo type is allowed on a route. Returns whether cargo is allowed, requirements, and alternatives.

route_id.description: Route identifier to check. Optional if origin/destination provided.

origin.description: Origin city. Used with destination if route_id not provided.

destination.description: Destination city. Used with origin if route_id not provided.

name: freight_calculate_estimate
description: Calculate freight cost estimate. Returns detailed cost breakdown including base rate, fuel surcharge, and accessorial charges. Requires origin, destination, and either weight_kg or volume_cbm.

origin.description: Origin city or facility name. Required.

destination.description: Destination city or facility name. Required.

weight_kg.description: Cargo weight in kilograms. Required if volume_cbm not provided.

volume_cbm.description: Cargo volume in cubic meters. Required if weight_kg not provided.

cargo_type.description: Cargo category. Affects pricing surcharges. Optional.

service_level.description: Service level. Affects transit time and cost.

carrier_id.description: Specific carrier ID to use (format: C followed by 3 digits, e.g., C001). Optional. If omitted, the first available carrier in the database is used and the chosen carrier is echoed in the quote result.

name: freight_compare_carriers
description: Compare freight quotes from multiple carriers. Returns quotes with rates and transit times, highlighting best options.

origin.description: Origin city or facility name. Required.

destination.description: Destination city or facility name. Required.

volume_cbm.description: Cargo volume in cubic meters. Optional.

carriers.description: List of 1-5 specific carrier IDs to compare. Optional. If omitted, compares up to 5 available carriers.

name: freight_get_transit_time
description: Get estimated transit time between locations. Returns minimum, maximum, and average transit days.

origin.description: Origin city or facility name. Required.

destination.description: Destination city or facility name. Required.

service_level.description: Service level. Affects transit time. Optional.
